notes:
MangaView edit-toolbar Download button now calls LargeDownloadConfirmation.needsConfirmation(chapterCount:defaults: .standard). When true it holds the chapters in `pendingDownloadChapters` and shows an alert with Download and Cancel buttons. Download calls the shared helper `queueDownload(chapters:)`, which holds the Wi-Fi check and queue path. Cancel clears the held chapters and queues nothing. Nit: the `DOWNLOAD_N_CHAPTERS_CONFIRM` key is in no Localizable.strings file, and the write set excludes those files. The title uses NSLocalizedString(..., value: "Download %d chapters?") as a fallback, so the key still needs adding to en.lproj. The slice gate only builds the Aidoku area (its test run is over the slice budget).
review: classified at medium by swiftgate judge diff-risk
